title: Two Elderly Women in Yard, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait from the 1940s depicting two elderly women standing side-by-side in a dirt and grass yard. Both women are wearing patterned floral day dresses characteristic of mid-century American fashion. The woman on the right rests her hand on a rustic wooden ladder-back chair. In the background, a small house, an old car, fence posts, and overhead power lines are visible under a clear sky.
